Title: Open source API portal now generally availabile

Body.Content:
Open source API portal key features include:

  • A drag-and-drop visual editor to customize the portal without writing code.
  • A GitHub-based API ecosystem including automated deployments with GitHub Actions and free hosting with GitHub Pages.

This open source project is available on GitHub and is licensed under the MIT license.  It utilizes the same key technologies as Azure API Management's developer portal, which is used by thousands of Azure customers.

Learn more.
